en: A black-and-white image of an industrial or institutional complex, likely from the early 20th century. The buildings feature multi-storey rectangular forms with steep, hipped roofs and small dormer windows. Several towers with spires are visible, hinting at a mixture of institutional and industrial uses. A tall smokestack dominates the right side of the postcard, with visible smoke indicating factory activity. The background shows a European hillside town with dense housing and more church spires.
